findings.blocking_for: Durable QUVA extraction resume across a normal input refresh; repair before formal extraction
findings.title: Raw QUVA manifest changes when extraction outputs become available
findings.evidence_type: Static deterministic path; not executed on GPU
findings.defect: prepare writes quva_raw_inputs.json from prediction_rows. A QUVA row initially has no sha256; prepare adds the generated feature sha256 whenever that video's completion marker exists, then includes it in quva_raw_inputs.json. extraction_binding hashes this file and extract compares the result with the first QUVA_BINDING.json before reaching per-video reuse. Therefore prepare after any completed QUVA output changes the raw-input binding even though the raw videos, parameters and destination paths are unchanged. A later extractor continuation asserts at native_extract.py:84. This also makes the completed extraction non-idempotent after the required final prepare. The documented prepare/cpu-refresh path can run when independent author acquisition advances; it must not invalidate partial QUVA progress.
findings.minimal_repair: Construct quva_raw_inputs.json from a raw/extraction-input whitelist that excludes the generated feature sha256. Keep sha256 in prediction_inputs.json for training/evaluation qualification. Reuse the existing binding mechanism; no additional hash scheme or scientific change is needed.
findings.bounded_closure: One server CPU-only metadata fixture: raw manifest before and after adding a valid QUVA completion receipt must remain identical, while prediction_inputs receives the feature SHA. No decoder/model/whole-data rerun or GPU forward.

findings.evidence_type: Static output-schema inspection; formal outputs not executed
findings.defect: The frozen evaluation.outputs requires per-video and total timing. Per-video infer_seconds/total_seconds are stored, but METRICS_357.json and COMPLETE.json contain no aggregate timing or observed evaluation invocation duration. QUVA_COMPLETE likewise only embeds per-video seconds. A complete marker can therefore be emitted without the requested total cost record, especially with reused outputs across invocations.
findings.minimal_repair: Include clearly labelled sums of retained per-video inference/total seconds and the observed current invocation elapsed seconds in final completion evidence. Distinguish retained-output sums from invocation wall time and reuse count. Do not alter predictions, timing definitions, training workload, or rerun completed videos merely to fill this field.
